verses.latin: Paulus , Apostolus non ab hominibus, neque per hominem, sed per Jesum Christum, et Deum Patrem, qui suscitavit eum a mortuis:

verses.latin: Modo enim hominibus suadeo, an Deo? an quæro hominibus placere? si adhuc hominibus placerem, Christi servus non essem.

verses.latin: Notum enim vobis facio, fratres, Evangelium, quod evangelizatum est a me, quia non est secundum hominem:

verses.english: I went up in accordance with a revelation, and I laid before them the gospel I preach among the Gentiles. I did so privately before those who seemed to be of standing, lest I might be running, or might have run, in vain.

verses.translation_review: Latin–English editorial revision · checked against the Clementine Latin (7 November 2026) · specialist sign-off pending

verses.translation_review: Latin–English editorial revision · checked against the Clementine Latin (7 November 2026) · specialist sign-off pending

verses.english: Yet we know that a person is not justified by works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ. We too have believed in Christ Jesus so that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law, for by works of the law no flesh will be justified.”
